title: Yoisaki Kanade — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kanade's birthday
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
And thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, thank you.
I know you're busy with your band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's no trouble! You've helped me out so much, and I wanted to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I don't mean to cut right to the chase, but there's a song I'd like you to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A song? I see... That explains why you messaged me this morning saying to bring my earbuds.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's a birthday song I made just for today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just sent it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Okay, I'll give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday to you♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Miku's voice feels so warm and kind... This tuning is very well done.)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, dear Kanade♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hoshino.
This is really...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait... It's still going...)

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Happy birthday to you♪ Happy birthday to you♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Nene's Voices
rows.Line: <La la laa laa laa laa♪ La la la laa laa laa♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (These backing vocals... Is this Hoshino and Kusanagi?)

rows.Speaker: Minori & Honami's Voices
rows.Line: <La la laa laa laa laa♪ La la la laa laa laa♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And now it's Ms. Mochizuki and Hanasato...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Wait, now there's guitar and the hi-hat of the drums.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I see. The song must be about to really start. This is exciting.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hoshino.
I listened to the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. So... How was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was great.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: For the part at the beginning with just Miku singing, the tuning was so well done, and I could feel so much warmth and kindness in her voice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But then I realized that was just the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The band arrangement that came in once Kusanagi and the others joined in was also really good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The warm and kind feeling of it remained, but the song started to pick up and felt more lively as different instruments started coming in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The melody of the birthday song repeated throughout, but I never got bored listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th...Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I decided to try making an arrangement with the help of my bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, you might have recognized their voices, but I got Honami, Kusanagi and Minori to sing as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I knew it already, but you all really are good singers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And it was satisfying to hear the way your voices overlapped...
That being said, it didn't sound like you did much in the way of mixing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wow...!
I didn't think you'd pick up on that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Everyone's recordings turned out really well, for one thing, and I also thought using them as they were would lend the song more warmth.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. We included some castanets and a recorder too, and for those, I asked Kusanagi and Minori to help...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to talk so much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No worries.
I want to hear how the song was made.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, and since we're talking about it, I'd like to hear what made you decide to make it as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
Okay!
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here you are.
Two servings of Ms. Yoisaki's birthday “special plate”.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Salisbury steak, spaghetti and gratin.
There's fried shrimp and pudding too... This is a lot.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... We're really living the life of luxury.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Your birthday only comes once a year, after all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade!
Actually, I really wanted to say it in person...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But since I can't be there because of work, I made sure to put all my birthday wishes into Ichika's song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I hope you enjoy it. Have a great birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was thinking I'd like to celebrate somehow since we got to know each other and all, and that's when Hoshino asked me for help with her song...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hope you could feel some of my birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once again, Kanade, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't it great that she liked the song, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, I thought making a song would be the best way to show that everything she taught me is helping me out. I'm glad I did it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I enjoyed being able to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I wish you a very happy birthday, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'll continue coming by to cook delicious meals for you, so please look forward to them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya, Kanade!
Sounds like you've had a fun birthday. I'm glad♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As for us, it was nice that we were able to take it easy getting ready for tonight's party.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Take it easy? You forgot several things we needed, so we kept coming and going...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's just how we are, so it's all part of the package♪
Besides, we want to celebrate, and that's what's important!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, let's finish this off together.
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade.
Happy birthday, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everyone gave me so much warmth today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once a year, huh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to hold on to these feelings and keep doing my best this year.
